meta.title: EU inter-country input–output table at basic prices, industry by industry (FIGARO)
meta.note: EU-27 treated as one economy: all EU-27 destination countries are summed. Origin EU27 covers intra-EU supply (incl. the value-added and adjustment rows, c_orig=DOM); each other origin is that partner’s exports into EU-27 use. Rows: 64 NACE A*64 industries + B2A3G, D1, D21X31, D29X39, OP_RES, OP_NRES. Columns: 64 industries + P3_S13, P3_S14, P3_S15, P51G, P5M. Values rounded to €0.1 million. Regenerate: node scripts/fetch-figaro-io-dataset.mjs
